newsitem.title: UK: UK wool sale - strong competition for most types.
newsitem.headline: UK wool sale - strong competition for most types.

text.p: The second Bradford sale of the season saw strong competition for most types of wool with all prices ending fully firm, brokers reported.
Prices for Halfbreds and Northern Ireland wools were up 2.5 percent since the last Bradford sale on 6 September.
Forward wools sustained their popularity finding 85 percent clearance.
Noting the continuing strong demand for carpet wools, the British Wool Marketing Board's Liz Ambler said "We have been very pleased with the response to our decision to release extra stocks."
The Board plans to continue with this policy in the near-term, she said. The offering totalled 2,427,550 million kgs.
